History arrays and graph arithmetic execute in the VM; window geometry comes from the fixed fixture rectangle.
Font metrics use the explicit null-font fallback globals; this suite does not test loaded font tables.

Line/color/text/border callbacks compare logical requests only. clip_SetWin's clip-list state, palette application, f_1CE2_01F8 edge expansion, glyph masks, and framebuffer pixels are outside the claim; approved formatter view is only the private stack cursor and its semantic advance/count, with all raw differences retained.
required_effects: all raw nonstack bytes plus approved private formatter views
